title: Unit Review: The Press & Unconfirmed News
goal: Review the conditional of rumour, reported statements, headline style, passives in the news, and attribution and distance.
grammar: Unit Review: The Press & Unconfirmed News

items: I can pass on a report I have not confirmed, and say who said what.
I can read and write headlines and choose the right passive in a news report.
I can show how far I stand behind a claim.
